name: FPI
recent: 公司近期出现多项股权与董事变动，包括集团董事经理Shih Chao Yuan在9月10日至11日通过直接交易大幅减持直接与间接持股，同时独立非执行主席Leong Ngai Seng增持2.869%股权。公司于8月宣布以RM22.1百万出售Sungai Petani厂房，以整合生产至Port Klang，并预计录得RM10.9百万收益。此外，Cheong Hong Yip于10月1日被重新委任为董事经理。
notable: 集团董事经理Shih Chao Yuan于9月10日至11日通过直接交易减持直接与间接持股。
独立非执行主席Leong Ngai Seng于9月11日增持7,663,300股（2.869%）。
公司以RM22.1百万出售Sungai Petani厂房，预计录得RM10.9百万收益。
risks: 集团董事经理Shih Chao Yuan在9月10日至11日大幅减持直接与间接持股。
公司于9月有多项董事及大股东股权变动，包括OS Capital Sdn Bhd成为大股东及Wu Swee Ngor、Shih Chao Yuan不再是主要股东。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为RM182.95百万，环比增长134.3%，同比增长66.7%；净利为RM13.924百万，环比增长438.9%，净利率从3.3%提升至7.6%。

recent_en: The company has seen several equity and board changes recently, including Group Managing Director Shih Chao Yuan substantially disposing of direct and deemed interests via direct business transactions on 10 and 11 September, while Independent Non-Executive Chairman Leong Ngai Seng acquired a 2.869% stake. In August, the company announced the sale of its Sungai Petani factory for RM22.1 million to consolidate production in Port Klang, expecting a RM10.9 million gain. Additionally, Cheong Hong Yip was redesignated as Managing Director on 1 October.
notable_en: Group Managing Director Shih Chao Yuan disposed of direct and deemed interests via direct business transactions on 10-11 September.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Leong Ngai Seng acquired 7,663,300 shares (2.869%) on 11 September.
The company is selling its Sungai Petani factory for RM22.1 million, expecting a RM10.9 million gain.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Shih Chao Yuan substantially reduced direct and deemed shareholdings on 10-11 September.

Several board and substantial shareholder changes occurred in September, including OS Capital Sdn Bhd becoming a substantial shareholder and Wu Swee Ngor and Shih Chao Yuan ceasing to be substantial shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM182.95 million, up 134.3% QoQ and 66.7% YoY; net income was RM13.924 million, up 438.9% QoQ, with net margin improving from 3.3% to 7.6%.
